description: Evidence-backed semantic names for retail functions reachable from the DAH1 frontend. This registry is canonical; generated sub_ names remain unchanged.

symbols.role: Advances the frontend world, UI, managers, renderer, and per-frame shell services.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_0003.c: central frontend frame trace and ordered manager calls
tools/parity/MENU_ROUTE.md: frontend loop and world-step observations

symbols.role: Polls movie completion and asynchronous shell/level-switch readiness gates before forwarding completion.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_0003.c: calls MovieIsInactive and checks singleton fields 0x854/0x8D8

symbols.role: Accumulates frontend update time, fires the stored Lua callback at expiry, and handles repeat state.

tools/parity/MENU_ROUTE.md: timer callback layout

symbols.role: Stores the renderer presentation mode and translates it into the host presentation interval setting.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: mode values update renderer fields +0x27C/+0x2C8

symbols.role: Lua wrapper that reads one integer and invokes the renderer presentation-mode virtual.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: Lua integer conversion followed by renderer vtable slot +0x20

symbols.role: Applies the retail CRT lowercase classification to one byte.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: retail classification table and +0x20 lowercase conversion

symbols.role: Native implementation of Lua string.lower using the retail character conversion.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: registered Lua string.lower implementation

symbols.role: Maps three hashed float properties into an embedded three-component value and marks it dirty.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: writes +4/+8/+0xC and dirty byte +0x10

symbols.role: Handles three float properties and one helper action for a frontend object's embedded transform helper.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: float writes +0xB4/+0xB8/+0xBC and helper vtable call

symbols.role: On UI event type 9, hit-tests the object and invokes the embedded helper's first action before base forwarding.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: hit test then helper slot +4 and base event forward

symbols.role: On UI event type 9, hit-tests the object and invokes the embedded helper's second action before base forwarding.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: hit test then helper slot +8 and base event forward

symbols.role: Parses a six-value property payload and forwards two integers plus two parsed structures to its helper.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: property parsing and call to sub_001A3400

symbols.role: Destroys the helper owned at +0xB0, runs the frontend base destructor, and optionally frees the object.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_frontend_callbacks.c: helper virtual destructor, base destructor, conditional free

symbols.role: Returns true when the movie-active flag is clear.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_0013.c: inverted bit 0 of movie flags at 0x2867F4

symbols.role: Renders a fullscreen movie only while in fullscreen mode and a decoded presentation surface exists.
evidence: src/recomp/gen/recomp_0013.c: mode 2 and presentation-surface gate before sub_00122E50

symbols.role: Opens the requested Bink movie after the fade reaches black and enters fullscreen movie mode.

symbols.role: Clears the movie stop-related flag and closes either the in-engine or fullscreen movie path.

symbols.role: Processes movie input/skip state and advances either the in-engine or fullscreen decoder.

symbols.role: Unbinds, closes, and clears the active fullscreen Bink handle and starts deferred cleanup.

symbols.role: Reports whether the current decoded movie surface index is valid.
